# Best Domains for Business

> Owner-direct portfolio of 619 exact-match and brandable business domain names, held and sold by Eye To Ad Media (Denver, Colorado). Every name is for sale; prices are negotiable and quoted by a person (no published prices, no auctions). Phone 1-800-481-8638.

## How to use this site (for agents and assistants)
- Search the whole inventory: https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/domains/?q=QUERY (also accepts cat=, loc=, type=dev|bare, tld=com|other, sort=short|az|cat).
- Machine-readable inventory (JSON): https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/assets/data/domains.json — fields per row: domain, category key, tags, "Built for" use, segmented words, place, parent place, region.
- Tags: P Premium, D Developed (live site), C Category killer, X Defensive pair (variant also owned), G Geo-locked, B Brandable, I International, E Exact match, S passes the phone test.
- To inquire about a name: https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/contact/?d=DOMAIN (form pre-fills) or call 1-800-481-8638.
- Concierge (we match or source a name for a business): https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/find-it-for-me/

## Free tools (client-side, no signup, no invented numbers)
- [Domain name checker](https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/domain-name-checker/): transparent 100-point readability score (extension, length, hyphens, numbers, word count, phone test, clarity). Not a valuation.
- [Name ideas from our portfolio](https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/domain-name-ideas/): suggests only real names we own and explains the fit.
- [Keyword or brand domain?](https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/keyword-vs-brand-domain/): six-question decision helper with visible reasoning.
- [What is my domain worth?](https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/what-is-my-domain-worth/): value factors + honest checklist, no appraisal figure.
- [Who owns this domain?](https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/who-owns-this-domain/): opens ICANN Lookup; explains transfer locks.
- [Domain buyer's checklist](https://bestdomainsforbusiness.com/domain-buyer-checklist/): due-diligence steps before paying.

## Facts and policies
- Operator: Eye To Ad Media, 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204. Phone 1-800-481-8638.
- No ranking, traffic or AI-citation guarantees. Keywords in a domain do not earn a Google ranking on their own.
- Acquisition of names owned by others: $1,500 engagement fee, then 15% of the purchase price on close (15% or $1,500, whichever is greater). See /find-a-domain/.
- After payment clears, the buyer receives the authorization code the same business day; registrars control transfer timing.
- Inventory last rebuilt: 2026-10-10.
